tools.name: ai_upscale_image
tools.description: Upscale an image 2x or 4x with AI. Costs 8 credits for 2x and 12 for 4x, refunded if it fails. Needs a CropDen API key. Input: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB; longest side up to 2048 px for 2x or 1024 px for 4x. Returns a link to the result, valid 7 days.

tools.name: ai_remove_background
tools.description: Remove the background of an image with AI; the result is a PNG with transparency. Costs 1 credit per run, refunded if it fails. Needs a CropDen API key. Input: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB and 2048 px on the longest side. Returns a link to the result, valid 7 days.

tools.name: get_ai_task
tools.description: Status of an AI run that was still working when its tool returned. Pass the task_id it gave you; wait about 10 seconds between checks.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: How many CropDen credits the API key owner has left.
